exact_title: The Effects of Dapagliflozin in Patients With Heart Failure Complicated With Type 2 Diabetes: A Meta-Analysis of Placebo-Controlled Randomized Trials
source_type: systematic review and meta-analysis of placebo-controlled randomized trials
sections_or_headings: Methods — Selection Criteria and Data Extraction
Effect of Dapagliflozin on Hospitalization for Heart Failure
Effect of Dapagliflozin on Cardiovascular Death
Effect of Dapagliflozin on All-Cause Mortality

figures.title: Flow diagram for data searching and selecting process
figures.key_content: 429 database records; 40 duplicates and 368 records removed before screening; 21 screened; 16 excluded (11 not RCT, 5 without selected outcomes); 5 studies included. Intermediate report-retrieval boxes are labeled n=0 and are internally inconsistent with the final inclusion count.

figures.title: Risk of bias assessed by Cochrane RoB 2
figures.key_content: McMurray, Singh, and Wiviott are shown as low risk overall; Leiter is shown with some concerns overall; Yang is shown high risk overall with a high-risk randomization-process judgment.

figures.title: All-heart-failure pooled effects for HHF, CVD, and ACM
figures.key_content: HHF OR 0.74 (0.61-0.88), I²=0%; CVD OR 0.84 (0.69-1.03), I²=0%; Figure 3C ACM OR 0.79 (0.66-0.94), I²=0%, which conflicts with prose OR 0.76.

figures.title: HFpEF subgroup effects
figures.key_content: CVD OR 1.45 (0.95-2.22), I²=0%; ACM OR 1.04 (0.76-1.43), I²=0%. No HFpEF HHF analysis was presented.

tables.title: Demographics and baseline characteristics of the included study
tables.key_content: Five trial rows; all dapagliflozin 10 mg/day versus placebo. Table 1 lists full-trial McMurray arms 2,373/2,371, which does not match the stated diabetic subgroup used for the meta-analysis.

tables.title: Result of GRADE quality assessment
tables.key_content: HHF (4 RCTs), CVD (5 RCTs), and ACM (4 RCTs) are each labeled high quality/critical importance with no serious concern in the four listed GRADE domains.

algorithms_or_workflows.key_content: Required sample sizes: HHF 1,538; CVD 9,773; ACM 4,791; authors state ~1,916 additional CVD samples are needed.

appendices_or_supplements.status: not present in selected source folder

omitted_with_reason: No separate supplement was supplied; no visual was omitted from the main-text PDF.

coverage_decision: Full 10-page primary PDF inspected. All main-text figures and tables were visually reconciled against rendered pages and represented in the SEA as structured blocks. References were extracted separately and not atomized as evidence.
omissions: The bibliography itself was not atomized.
No separate supplementary material was available in the selected Drive folder.
source_consistency_flags: The pooled total of 5,252 is arithmetically consistent with using 2,139 diabetic participants from McMurray 2019, but the next Results sentence states 2,319; Table 1 lists the full McMurray trial arms (2,373 + 2,371 = 4,744).
Figure 3C reports pooled all-cause mortality OR 0.79 (95% CI 0.66-0.94), while the Results prose and abstract report OR 0.76 with the same interval.

The abstract reports HFrEF cardiovascular-death I²=8% and all-cause-mortality OR 0.70 (95% CI 0.50-0.99; I²=43%); the main Results text/Figure 4 report CVD I²=0% and ACM OR 0.69 (95% CI 0.53-0.89; I²=16%).
Figure 1's PRISMA flow shows 21 records screened and 5 studies included, but the intermediate 'reports sought for retrieval' and 'reports assessed for eligibility' boxes are both labeled n=0.
The Discussion says two trials had >1,000 participants and 'the other four trials' had <1,000 participants despite only five trials being included.
